fields.finding: Reference calculations assume 90% of the chosen release inventory was removed and the residue releases exponentially with one-day time constant. Neither fraction nor kinetics is demonstrated.
fields.proposed_next: Demonstrate the required residual gas load after conditioning; do not treat this as a prescribed bake process.
